name: Probability Core
description: Weighted random that can be audited afterwards. Every draw is taken from a seeded stream and logged with the seed cursor, the table used and the result, so any pull can be reproduced exactly — which is the only durable answer to an accusation of rigging, and the reason this exists instead of a call to a random function. Rates are PUBLISHED: the declared odds are an output, not a comment, and the component refuses a table whose weights do not sum to the advertised rates rather than quietly normalising them, because silent normalisation is how a disclosed 1% becomes an actual 0.7%. Uniform dice belong to utility.dice_roll_resolver, whose odds the notation already discloses; this owns tables whose odds must be stated.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: tables
inputs.description: Weighted tables keyed by id, each entry carrying an outcome and a weight. Required — the odds are the product.

inputs.name: publishedRates
inputs.description: Advertised probability per outcome. Checked against the weights on load; a mismatch is refused rather than normalised.

inputs.name: logCapacity
inputs.description: Draws retained for audit before the oldest is dropped.

inputs.name: refuseUnpublishedTables
inputs.description: Whether a table with no declared rates may be drawn from at all. True is the honest default for anything a player pays into.

outputs.name: declaredRates
outputs.description: The published probability per outcome, for display.

outputs.name: drawLog
outputs.description: Recent draws with their seed cursors, for audit.
